_: OB16 (09.11.2026): where the conical king crab pots stand in stacks on each coastal model, in the game's frame (x starboard, y up, z aft, metres from the model's middle). at: [x, y, z, ry, h] per stack (h the most to that stack, under what stands over it and never over six on the boats under 12 m), spot where a hauled pot is emptied (null: aft of the pot hand by the hauler, view3d/10-gear.js potDeck). Found on the deck map (vessel3d.js deckMap) where a 1.45 m ring stands on one floor with the stack's height clear over it, clear of the hauler, the crew's places at it (deckcrew.js places: the two hauling, the picker, the pot hand), the place where a pot is emptied and the room to tip it inboard, the crab tank, the model's own gutting table and tub, the cargo and the crane; the nearest to the hauler first. Read by the boat scripts (kit_places, potplaces.pots) and written into the exported models by python3 tools/boats/potplaces.py. The models without an entry have no room for a stack (the havsjark, kyst15, and the plastsjark: OB7 09.11.2026, her deck aft takes a stack or the place where a pot is tipped, not both; Jonas: «Ingen teiner»).
